copy.npr_heading: Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: Long hours at a desk or relaxing on the couch can leave your lower back craving warmth. This Sunbeam heating pad delivers focused heat with five settings, a flexible polyester design and an adjustable strap for waists up to 54 inches. The soft, machine-washable cover makes regular use easy.
copy.npr_long_copy:
When you’re sitting at a desk or settling in for an evening on the couch, keeping a heating pad in place can be difficult. This Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad wraps around your waist with an adjustable strap, helping keep focused warmth where you want it while you work or relax. Its flexible design improves body contact for a closer fit.

Five heat settings let you choose the warmth that suits the moment, while the digital controller makes adjustments simple from your seat. The pad heats up in 90 seconds, so you won’t be waiting long before warmth starts. Its 110W heating system and temperature-sensing technology help maintain consistent heat during use.

A 3-hour auto-off function switches this heating pad off after continuous use, while the detachable controller makes cleaning easier. The 220cm cord gives you room to position yourself near a power outlet, and the soft polyester fabric feels comfortable against clothing or skin. When the evening is over, you can remove the controller and machine wash the pad.

Finished in Grey, this heating pad measures 370mm wide by 370mm high and weighs 0.95kg. It comes with a 2-year warranty and suits anyone who wants focused warmth while reading, working on a laptop or watching TV. After use, detach the controller, wash the pad when needed and fold it away ready for the next cool evening.

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Cooking several dishes can quickly fill a kitchen with vapour and odours. This 120cm ducted rangehood uses five fan speeds, LED lighting and a 15-minute auto shut-off timer to manage cooking air, while dishwasher-safe black mesh filters make cleaning easier.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Large cooktops can leave overhead cabinetry crowded and cooking vapours difficult to manage. This 120cm ducted undermount rangehood fits into 300mm-deep cabinetry, keeping the appliance discreet while giving broad coverage across a large cooking area. Its Black Steel finish suits contemporary kitchens where you want extraction equipment to sit neatly out of sight.

When you’re simmering, frying or cooking several burners at once, five speed levels let you match airflow to the meal. The Isodrive® SPINL motor supports powerful extraction, while the inline design keeps the motor separate from the canopy. A 15-minute auto shut-off timer lets this rangehood continue clearing the air after cooking, so you don’t need to return to the controls straight away.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display keep speed selection clear while you’re moving between pans. Built-in LED lighting brightens the cooktop, helping you see food as it cooks without relying only on the kitchen’s main lights. Black mesh stainless steel filters capture grease, and they’re dishwasher-safe for easier cleaning after regular cooking.

This ducted rangehood includes Schweigen SteelFlex™ and has a 10-year motor warranty, five-year canopy warranty, lifetime filter warranty and lifetime GU10 LED globe warranty. Its 1180mm width suits large cooktops or island benches, while the 285mm height and 295mm depth support discreet undermount installation. Picture it tucked into overhead joinery as dinner simmers below, with the lights on and the timer handling the final clearing cycle.
